Dom wants to build a daily visual learning habit using Obsidian + Excalidraw, anchored around a specific image that carries personal meaning. ## Vision

Opening Obsidian each day shows the anchor image immediately — no searching, no decisions. The Inform Team is building a genuine technical capability — one that matches the ambition of what we do with the architectural depth it deserves. We're looking for a Chief Architect to own the technical direction of that capability, inside our business and across our client base.

This is a foundational appointment. You will be our first architecture-level leader — the person who defines what good looks like technically, builds the practice around it, and makes sure everything we design and deliver holds up under scrutiny.

The role spans two missions:

**Client-facing architecture.** You will be the trusted technical mind behind how our clients — primarily Microsoft 365 and Copilot-adopting organisations — design secure, well-governed, future-ready solutions. You are the person senior stakeholders trust to translate business ambition into a credible technical plan.

**Internal transformation — our Frontier Firm ambition.** You will own the strategic direction of how we transform the way we work internally, using AI agents to reinvent our own processes. This is not a side project — it's a strategic priority with dedicated attention. You design how human-agent teams operate, set the guardrails, run the pilots, and create the patterns the rest of the business adopts. You set the standard that others follow.

Beyond delivery, you hold accountability for our technical credibility as a business: our approach to Microsoft partnership, the quality of our architecture thinking, and the growth of a practice that didn't exist before you joined.

---
